note: Verifies how ingress2gateway v1.1.0 translates a real annotated nginx Ingress into Gateway API objects — what the core absorbs, what it drops, and where the translation is syntactically valid but semantically wrong. Deterministic offline transform; no statistical distribution applies. Source of truth: the committed expected/*.yaml and expected/*.warn.txt.
subject: ingress2gateway 1.1.0 (provider: ingress-nginx, emitter: standard)

absorbed_into_core.claim: A separate canary Ingress (canary-weight: 10) merges with the main route into ONE HTTPRoute with native weighted backendRefs (frontend-next weight 10 + frontend weight 90). The annotation hack becomes a first-class field.
absorbed_into_core.evidence: expected/convert-standard.yaml -> HTTPRoute vargg-canary-var-gg, rule with backendRefs[].weight

absorbed_into_core.claim: enable-cors + cors-allow-origin become a type: CORS filter, emitted in STANDARD output with NO experimental flag — firsthand confirmation that the CORS filter graduated to Standard.
ssl-redirect becomes a separate HTTP(:80) HTTPRoute with a type: RequestRedirect filter forcing HTTP -> HTTPS.
absorbed_into_core.evidence: expected/convert-standard.yaml -> :80 listener + HTTPRoute with filters[].type: RequestRedirect

absorbed_into_core.claim: rewrite-target becomes a type: URLRewrite filter with ReplaceFullPath.
TLS (cert-manager secret) becomes a Gateway listener certificateRefs (Secret ref), with 443 and 80 listeners split.
absorbed_into_core.evidence: expected/convert-standard.yaml -> Gateway listeners var-gg-https (443, tls.certificateRefs: vargg-tls) + var-gg-http (80)

absorbed_into_core.claim: The /api(/|$)(.*) regex path becomes matches[].path.type: RegularExpression.

dropped_with_warning.claim: limit-rps (rate limit) is Unsupported and dropped — rate limiting is still outside the Gateway API core.
configuration-snippet (raw nginx) is Unsupported and dropped — the escape hatch disappears; the hardest part of any real migration.
force-ssl-redirect is flagged Unsupported (though the ssl-redirect RequestRedirect path covers it in practice).
proxy-body-size is dropped by STANDARD_EMITTER on the grounds that 'most implementations have reasonable defaults'.
dropped_with_warning.evidence: expected/convert-standard.warn.txt -> WARN STANDARD_EMITTER '... proxy-body-size ... reasonable body size and buffering defaults'

dropped_with_warning.claim: Gateway API cannot configure URL normalization (RFC 3986 sec 6); the tool warns.
dropped_with_warning.evidence: expected/*.warn.txt -> WARN STANDARD_EMITTER 'does not support configuring URL normalization'

converted_but_semantically_broken.claim: The nginx rewrite-target /$2 is copied verbatim into ReplaceFullPath: /$2. Gateway API URLRewrite does NOT interpret nginx regex backreferences ($2) — syntax was translated but meaning is broken. Applying the output as-is misroutes traffic. The tool emits NO capture-group warning here (v1.1.0), so it leaks silently.
converted_but_semantically_broken.evidence: expected/timeout-probe.out.yaml -> urlRewrite.path.replaceFullPath: /$2 (literal); NO capture-group warning in expected/timeout-probe.warn.txt
converted_but_semantically_broken.severity: high — this is the most honest firsthand finding: the converter is a starting point, not an answer

converted_but_semantically_broken.claim: proxy-read-timeout: 30 (a 30s TCP idle timeout) becomes timeouts.request: 5m0s — a whole-request timeout, ~10x the TCP value. Not a unit bug; an intentional best-effort approximation (tcpTimeoutMultiplier=10) that changes the meaning. The tool warns to verify.
converted_but_semantically_broken.evidence: expected/timeout-probe.out.yaml -> timeouts.request: 5m0s; expected/timeout-probe.warn.txt -> WARN 'ingress-nginx only supports TCP-level timeouts; i2gw has made a best-effort translation ... Please verify'

converted_but_semantically_broken.claim: Path regex is translated somewhat messily to (?i)/api(/|$)(.*).* with an INFO warning that case-insensitive regex is in use and 'you may want to change this' — hand-fixing needed.
converted_but_semantically_broken.evidence: expected/timeout-probe.out.yaml -> path.value: (?i)/api(/|$)(.*).*; expected/*.warn.txt -> INFO 'Using case-insensitive regex path matches'

freshness_correction.claim: The scout said 'ingress2gateway 1.0 (2026-03)'; the actual latest at run time was v1.1.0 (released 2026-05-12).
freshness_correction.evidence: generator annotation ingress2gateway-1.1.0 on every emitted object in expected/*.yaml
